blocks.question: 2024-MAY-TZ1-P2-Q03
blocks.task_summary: Find the probability that X is more than 1.5 standard deviations above the mean.
method_path: Recognize that X > mean + 1.5*SD corresponds to X > 13 (or Z > 1.5)
Calculate P(X > 13) or P(Z > 1.5) using GDC normal CDF

evidence.basis: recognition of 13 X > OR 1.5 Z > (could be seen in a diagram) (M1) then P(13) 0.0668072... X > = 0.0668 = A1

blocks.question: 2024-MAY-TZ1-P2-Q03
blocks.task_summary: Find the number of standard deviations k such that the probability that X is more than k standard deviations above the mean is 0.1.
method_path: Set up normal CDF equation (e.g., P(X > 10 + 2k) = 0.1 or P(Z > k) = 0.1) or recognize need for inverse normal
Use inverse normal with left-tail area 0.9 or right-tail 0.1 to obtain k ≈ 1.28
accepted_alternatives: Equation approach: equate appropriate normal CDF to 0.1 or 0.9 and solve
Direct inverse normal: use GDC invNorm with area 0.9 or 0.1

evidence.basis: EITHER equating an appropriate correct normal CDF function to 0.1 or 0.9 (M1) OR recognising need to use inverse normal with 0.1 or 0.9 (M1) THEN k = 1.28155... = 1.28 A1
